title: O3DE Workspace Schema 2.0.0
description: Schema 2.0.0 for O3DE workspace. A workspace is a local build artifact that links source objects into a unified directory tree with symlinks.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the workspace was created.

root_object.description: The root O3DE object path used to create this workspace.

root_type.description: The object type of the root (engine, project, gem, etc.).

platforms.description: Platform selection used when composing this workspace. Platform-specific overlays are included only if they deliver one of these platforms (family overlays are pulled in via overlay dependencies). Absent means all platforms.

attributions.description: Where composed overlays' object metadata (overlay.json, licenses, icon, docs) is recorded: 'workspace' = ledger at <workspace>/Overlays/<overlay-name>/ (default), 'object' = inside the extended object, 'off' = not recorded.

overlay_order.description: Explicit overlay apply order per extended object: base object name → ordered overlay names (first applied first, so later entries win file conflicts). Overrides the overlays' authored precedence for this workspace.

sources.description: Categorised source objects resolved into this workspace. Each category maps object names to their absolute local paths. Names are scoped by type, so a gem and a project may share a name without collision.

engines.description: Engine objects: name → absolute local path.

projects.description: Project objects: name → absolute local path.

gems.description: Gem objects: name → absolute local path.

templates.description: Template objects: name → absolute local path.

overlays.description: Overlay objects: name → absolute local path.

file_links.description: Map of source absolute POSIX paths to workspace-relative POSIX paths. Each entry records a file link from the source object into the workspace directory tree. The owner of a file can be derived by matching the source path against the source roots in the sources field.
